title: Opening, Zoom setup and the piano as best friend
summary: Copyright notes and introduction to the July 2020 Covid interview; Rowe greets Sportiello in his West Village apartment and mentions his Thou Swell video.

The Covid-19 pandemic impacted the music and arts community particularly hard. Musicians who had previously been interviewed for the Fillius Jazz Archive graciously shared their experiences during this virtual shutdown period. The political and racial unrest occurring simultaneously was also addressed.
Rossano was interviewed via Zoom on July 20, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe at Hamilton College for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m with Rossano Sportiello today from his apartment in Manhattan is it?
That’s right. In the West Village.
In the West Village, and I see your piano. You’re always near a piano it seems like.
Well you know it’s, especially these days I think the piano became my best friend, more than ever.
Yesterday I watched your performance of “Thou Swell.”
